concerns.text: T005 (data_loader) is listed before T006 (config.py). The data loader likely reads configuration constants defined in src/config.py, so the consumer (T005) precedes its producer (T006), violating the required producer‑before‑consumer ordering.

T010 (correlation between human ratings and automated metrics) is scheduled before T012 (persist human ratings) and before T019 (metric extraction). Both inputs are needed for the correlation, so T010 runs as a consumer before its producers, breaking the data‑flow order.

T028 (baseline task handler) appears before T028a (RT measurement mechanism). The baseline handler invokes the RT mechanism, making T028 a consumer of T028a, but the producer is listed later, causing an ordering violation.
